Fluid Art Workshop

FA

Explore the fascinating world of acrylic pouring and fluid art in this immersive workshop. Learn how colors interact naturally to create abstract patterns, unique textures, and stunning artworks without requiring traditional painting skills. Each participant takes home a one-of-a-kind masterpiece created during the session.
